cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-create-reports-document-state
cases.purpose: Creating a session from text exposes title, outline and footnotes.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-render-inline-styles-and-links
cases.purpose: A paragraph renders every run with its style and keeps links clickable.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-render-block-structure
cases.purpose: Headings, lists, tasks, quotes, code and tables all reach the buffer.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-footnotes-numbered-and-defined
cases.purpose: Footnote references render numbered and definitions appear at the end.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-media-cards-show-placeholders
cases.purpose: Missing local media renders a labeled card instead of failing.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-media-keeps-source-aspect-under-height-cap
cases.purpose: A media card capped by height narrows its grid instead of squashing the source.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-local-media-opens-with-the-desktop
cases.purpose: RET on a local media card asks the desktop to open the file instead of loading it into Emacs.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-refresh-re-reads-a-file
cases.purpose: Refresh re-reads the file and publishes the new outline.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-theme-changes-and-rejects-unknown
cases.purpose: Themes cycle in order and unknown palettes are rejected.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-locate-follows-the-outline
cases.purpose: Locate moves point to the heading band and next/previous walk the outline.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-close-releases-and-reopens
cases.purpose: Closing kills the buffer and the same session mounts again.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-front-matter-is-metadata
cases.purpose: Front matter is stripped from the body and feeds the title.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-flavor-commonmark-keeps-extensions-literal
cases.purpose: The CommonMark flavor leaves GFM-only syntax as literal text.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-flavor-gfm-converts-extensions
cases.purpose: The GFM flavor converts the extensions the previewer defaults to.

cases.name: etaf-md-preview-tests-flavor-rejects-unknown-name
cases.purpose: An unknown dialect name is reported instead of guessed.
